title: Graduated voucher windows + enterprise preflight auto-response
creator: Aisha Patel
description: A controlled experiment to replace a single bulk onboarding credit with a graduated voucher window model and to add an automated enterprise 'preflight' response that extends access when a prospective customer completes the security questionnaire. Goal is to increase PLG conversion efficiency and accelerate enterprise handoffs for high-risk accounts.
background: Current starter credit is a one-time token allocation that expires after 30 days. We see two failure patterns: a) heavy initial consumption with no follow-up (low conversion), b) enterprise prospects drop out early because security/compliance checks are manual and cause friction. Previous experiments focused on credit size and expiry but did not link credits to enterprise pre-sales flows.
hypothesis: If we issue onboarding credits as staggered 'vouchers' unlocked over the first 30 days and automatically extend access (voucher unlock and credit refresh) when an organization completes the security questionnaire preflight, then engaged users will convert at higher rates and enterprise prospects will move faster to contract conversations.
success_metrics: 7-day active user conversion rate: +15% relative to control
30-day paid conversion rate: +8% relative to control
Enterprise MQL->SQL time: median reduce by 25% for SQ-complete orgs
Retention of trial cohorts at 30 days: +10%
False positive extension rate (auto-extended but never qualifying): <5%
experiment_design:
Randomized 3-arm A/B test across new signups during a 6-week window:
  - Control: existing single bulk credit (30d expiry)
  - Arm A: Graduated vouchers (3 unlock windows: day0=40%, day7=30%, day21=30%), same total value
  - Arm B: Graduated vouchers + enterprise preflight auto-response. If account completes security questionnaire and matches enterprise criteria, immediately unlock remaining vouchers + one-time extension of 14 days.
  Allocation 40% control / 30% A / 30% B. Track cohort-level metrics and funnel events.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag deployment to backend and console for vouchers. 2) Add SQ preflight webhook and a lightweight assurance check. 3) Soft launch to 10% for 1 week, validate instrumentation and no regressions. 4) Ramp to full experiment allocation. 5) Analyze 6-week cohorts and run statistical bootstrapping for lift estimates.
tasks: Finalize voucher allocation schedule and UI copy
Implement voucher state machine in billing runtime (ENG)
Instrument events: voucher_unlocked, voucher_redeemed, sq_submitted, sq_verified
Build SQ preflight lightweight verification and mapping to account tiers
Create dashboard in Looker for cohort metrics and margin impact
Draft support FAQ and user email flows for extended access
Run legal check for auto-extension messaging and enterprise hooks
acceptance_criteria: Experiment is live behind feature flag and routed correctly to cohorts
All instrumented events appear in analytics with <5s latency
SQ webhook triggers auto-unlock for qualifying orgs and logs an audit event
No regressions in billing calculations and no increase in failed charges
Support FAQ and product copy reviewed by Legal and Design
risks: Potential abuse: users creating multiple accounts to get staggered vouchers
Overextending credits to low-propensity users increasing cost without conversion
SQ auto-extensions triggering enterprise outreach for low-fit orgs
mitigations: Tie voucher eligibility to device/email heuristics and rate-limit new accounts
Monitor cost-per-conversion and set kill-switch if margin hits threshold
Add heuristics for enterprise fit (company size, email domain) before auto-extension
End-to-end test suite for instrumentation and a pre-rollout smoke test
